name: French Lieux-dits and Boxes
description: A named place on a line of its own, the words lieu-dit, and the three kinds of box (BP, CS, TSA), with a street and without, and a five-digit box number that is not a postcode. Original cases written for this corpus from La Poste's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes and communes are La Poste's base officielle (Licence Ouverte 2.0).
